fees.description: This fee may apply when disconnecting power to your property. Additional charges may be incurred for after hours requests, site-visits and non-payment cases. This is a network charge, which Nectr passes through. Actual fee may vary.
This fee may apply when reconnecting power to your property. Additional charges may be incurred for after hours requests or site-visits.
This fee may apply when a customer requests the network undertake a special meter read.

electricityContract.terms: This offer is available to customers with an applicable network tariff. If you are unsure of your network tariff, please contact us to check this offer is available to you. Billing will be either monthly or quarterly, depending on your meter type, with a payment term of 10 business days. For more details on the terms and conditions, visit nectr.com.au/terms-and-conditions/#contracts, contact Nectr on hello@nectr.com.au or call 1300 111 211.

discounts.description: $150 credit added on your electricity account when you sign up using a Refer a Friend link from an existing Nectr customer. Available to new customers only. T&Cs apply. Please refer to nectr.com.au/terms-and-conditions/nectr-refer-a-friend-program/

electricityContract.variation: We may vary your rates and charges once every 12 months by providing you with at least 10 business days notice before any increase, and at least 5 business days notice before any decrease to your charges.

singleRate.description: Hours of application are determined by your distributor, Evoenergy. For more information, please contact your network distributor.

electricityContract.additionalFeeInformation: Additional fees and charges may apply. Please see the Nectr fee schedules at nectr.com.au/plans-and-fees/evoenergy/
